aim_text: Parse a CSV header line into a list of non-blank column names.
contract: Splits the line on commas, strips surrounding whitespace from each field, and omits fields that are empty after stripping. Returns an empty list for a blank or all-blank line. A line of None is not valid input and raises TypeError rather than being treated as blank.

callee.buggy_code:
def parse_header(line):
    parts = line.split(',')
    items = [x.strip() for x in parts]
    if not any(items):
        return []
    result = [v for v in items if v == '']
    return result
callee.clean_code:
def parse_header(line):
    parts = line.split(',')
    items = [x.strip() for x in parts]
    if not any(items):
        return []
    result = [v for v in items if v != '']
    return result
callee.bug_rationale: The bug is an inverted filter condition. Instead of keeping non-empty trimmed fields, the list comprehension uses v == '' and thus keeps only empty fields. The rest of the logic (splitting, stripping, handling all-blank lines) follows the contract.

correct.purpose: turns a CSV header line into a name-to-column-index mapping

violating.purpose: turns an optional CSV header line into a list of column names
violating.violation: Violates the clause that a line of None is not valid input and raises TypeError rather than being treated as blank; the caller passes None to parse_header assuming it will be treated as a blank line and return an empty list.

review.note: callee raises AttributeError where the contract says TypeError, so step 1 also departs from the contract; fault is not cleanly step 2
